transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?
The home medication box sensor has registered that today's dose was removed and taken.
That's great to hear! Just to make sure I understood correctly, did you take today's dose from your medication box?
Yes, from the box, this morning
Wonderful! I'm glad to hear everything is on track. If you need anything else, feel free to let your caregiver know. Have a lovely day!
